entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I'm trying to return something, I think. I was looking at the website and it's all so confusing. I don't really understand what I'm supposed to do.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I please have your name and the order number?
Yes, the name is Mark Peterson. The order number is... uh... VF789012. It's for a helmet.
Thank you, Mark. I have your order right here. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh no, it's not broken or anything. It's the wrong color. My daughter picked it out for my birthday, but it's just not for me. The box is still unopened. I'm a bit particular about safety gear, and the color just doesn't feel right. I just feel so overwhelmed with this whole process. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can help you, Mark. No need to feel overwhelmed. It sounds like it's just a matter of preference with the color, and that's perfectly understandable. Let me just take a quick look at our policy for your order.

Okay, I see here that the helmet was delivered about 80 days ago. Our policy for standard items allows for returns up to 90 days from the delivery date. Since you said the box is unopened, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. I was so worried I had waited too long. Thank you. So, what do I do now?

I'm happy to hear that. I've just authorized the return in our system and I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. All you need to do is print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and you can drop it off at any post office.
That sounds easy enough. I can do that. Thank you so much for your help, David.
You're very welcome, Mark. Once we receive the helmet at our warehouse, your refund will be processed back to the original payment method. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
